description: Automated workflow for grant application, review, approval, and fund disbursement in nonprofit sector.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where an Applicant submits a grant request, a Reviewer checks eligibility, an Approver authorizes the grant, and a Disburser releases funds.

agents.name: Applicant
agents.system_prompt: Submit grant application and supporting documents.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.system_prompt: Review application for eligibility and completeness.

agents.name: Approver
agents.system_prompt: Authorize grant if approved.

agents.name: Disburser
agents.system_prompt: Disburse grant funds to applicant.

description: Multi-agent workflow for academic publishing: submission, peer review, editorial decision, and publication.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Submitter sends a manuscript, a PeerReviewer evaluates it, an Editor makes a decision, and a Publisher posts the article.

agents.name: Submitter
agents.system_prompt: Submit manuscript for review.

agents.name: PeerReviewer
agents.system_prompt: Review manuscript for quality and relevance.

agents.name: Editor
agents.system_prompt: Make editorial decision on manuscript.

agents.name: Publisher
agents.system_prompt: Publish accepted manuscript.

agents.name: Trainer

agents.name: MatchPlanner

description: Multi-agent workflow for exhibition planning, artist coordination, installation, and event promotion.

agents.name: Planner

agents.name: Coordinator
agents.system_prompt: Coordinate with artists and manage logistics.

agents.name: Installer
agents.system_prompt: Install artwork and prepare exhibition space.

agents.name: Promoter

description: Automated workflow for mission design, crew assignment, launch preparation, and mission execution in aerospace.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Designer plans the mission, a CrewManager assigns crew, a LaunchPrepAgent prepares for launch, and an Executor runs the mission.

agents.name: Designer
agents.system_prompt: Design space mission objectives and parameters.

agents.name: CrewManager
agents.system_prompt: Assign crew members and manage training.

agents.name: LaunchPrepAgent
agents.system_prompt: Prepare spacecraft and crew for launch.

agents.name: Executor
agents.system_prompt: Execute mission and monitor progress.
